caption: The learner’s purpose connects all nine skills. Document use and continued learning remain visible across tasks. This is a planning map, not a sequence or proficiency scale.

after_heading: Bring the six approaches into one session
caption: Plan purpose, context, complexity, modelling, evidence and participation together. Revisit these decisions when the learner’s evidence changes.
alt: A connected path links six teaching approaches: learner-centred purpose, contextualized tasks, complexity, direct instruction, assessment and social-emotional interaction. A return arrow indicates that planning is iterative.

after_heading: 5. Collect evidence that can guide the next lesson
caption: An observed attempt informs the next teaching move. Keep the task, tools, support and version with the evidence; review transfer through a later task.
alt: A six-stage cycle moves from setting a task and criterion to observing, interpreting, teaching and feedback, trying again, and reviewing change or transfer. The centre reminds practitioners to record task, tools, support and version.
